items.title: Did Record Q4 Results and Store Expansion Just Shift AutoZone’s (AZO) Investment Narrative?
items.summary: AutoZone, Inc. reported past fourth-quarter 2026 results with sales of US$6,594.88 million, net income of US$931.59 million, and diluted EPS of US$56.05, all higher than a year earlier. The company passed US$20.00 billion in annual sales, opened a record 374 stores, and saw strong growth in its commercial business alongside softer DIY demand. Now we’ll examine how this strong commercial momentum and record store expansion shape AutoZone’s broader investment narrative and future...
